query:
MATCH (u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
RETURN u.name AS User, count(DISTINCT a.artifacttype) AS ArtifactTypes, count(DISTINCT a) AS ArtifactNodes, count(DISTINCT c) AS Computers, coalesce(sum(fo.findingcount), 0) AS Findings, coalesce(sum(fo.matchcount), 0) AS Matches
ORDER BY Computers DESC, ArtifactNodes DESC, Findings DESC
name: Profilehound - Users Ranked by Artifact Spread
description: Ranks users by how broadly their collapsed artifact evidence appears across computers.
